sloka: तस्या भूषण घोषेण वैदेह्या राक्षस अधिपः ।बभूव विमलो नीलः सघोष इव तोयदः ॥३-५२-२५॥
transliteration: tasyā bhūṣaṇa ghoṣeṇa vaidehyā rākṣasa adhipaḥ ।babhūva vimalo nīlaḥ saghoṣa iva toyadaḥ ॥3-52-25॥

translations.english: The lord of the demons by the side of Sita, princess of Videha with her jingling ornaments looked like the darkblue raincloud with its lightning and thunder.
